Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Single Server: logical decoding feature is now generally available

Body.Content:
The Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Single Server logical decoding feature is now generally available. We are also announcing general availability support for wal2json, a popular output plugin for logical decoding. Logical decoding makes the data from inserts, updates, and deletes available to you, and wal2json converts that data into a JSON object. This feature enables change data capture and data streaming scenarios.

Learn more.
